messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.13
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I believe that most people use the development version of Nvim-R from https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R but for those who still install either the Vimball or the Vimball I released a new version. The changes are:
Support for Python code in knitr chunks: integration with the R package reticulate and with the jedi-vim plugin.
New options: R_editing_mode, R_buffer_opts.
Minor bug fixes.
The Vimball is available at https://www.vim.org/scripts/script.php?script_id=2628 and the Vim package at https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/releases

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino
